text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hm, that group—they're engrossed in 
conversation. They aren't watching out for 
passersby. Should I warn them?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Boss. Forgive me for not noticing you 
right away. I happen to be in the middle 
of a patrol.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Preventing disruptions to public order is 
also my duty. I will continue to maintain 
heightened vigilance, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it looks like the previous group has 
started having their snacks. We must keep 
a sharp eye out for littering!
